title: The Welch function is not third-order sum-free

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
The paper proves that the Welch function is not third-order sum-free for every odd n >= 7, with an exact Kloosterman-sum formula counting the relevant elements and zero-sum subspaces.

Submission package revision. Lean checks supplied algebraic identities and finite-field certificates for n = 5 and n = 7. The complete general trace and character-sum proof is written mathematics; it is not a complete Lean formalisation. Finite computations are supporting checks, not the proof for all n. The successful prior repository CI is recorded in verification/previous-ci.json; no new local Lean rebuild is claimed by this package.
notes: Prepared for Finite Fields and Their Applications. Manuscript and new submission materials: CC BY 4.0; original code: MIT. Existing Hexagon preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00472v1. Human-understanding declaration retained: some parts.
